nodes.label: HoneBill assistant rules
nodes.rationale: Rules for working in the HoneBill repo, centered on keeping both _legacy trees untouched unless the user explicitly asks.

nodes.label: _legacy off-limits rule
nodes.source_location: `_legacy` folders are off-limits unless the user says so
nodes.rationale: Do not edit, move, rename, delete, format, refactor, or import _legacy from live code. It is excluded from tsconfig.json on purpose. Do not fix its type errors, stale names, or process.env usage, and do not include it in sweeping renames, lint fixes, or dependency cleanups. Read it only when the user asks for a reference. Otherwise build the frontend against mock data. If the user explicitly says to use or change _legacy, copy what is needed into live code rather than importing across the boundary, unless they say to move a folder back.
